title.narrative: Sustainable Textile Initiative: Together for Change (STITCH)

description.narrative: As the Sustainable Textile Initiative: Together for Change (STITCH) consortium, we envision a global garment industry that contributes to an equal and just society by respecting human rights in the world of work. The global garment industry is fragmented and complex, involving many actors across the globe, with varying levels of power and influence.

title.narrative: Increased collaboration
Number of influencing activities held with policymakers, companies, influential decision-makers on key STITCH Lobby and Advocacy goals/strategies

description.narrative: Influencing activities include dialogues, meetings, consultations, briefings, seminars, workshops, conferences, summits, etc. held with policymakers, companies, influential decision-makers on main STITCH issues, claims and policy goals

comment.narrative: Focusing on Mandatory HRDD in UK
Various including minimum wage work in Bangladesh, promotion of CFRPP etc.

Various, however we did not do as many CFRPP promotion activities as we focused on developing the HRDD framework. Primary focus was on Minimum wage advocacy in Bangladesh, UK legislation on Mandatory HRDD, an some CFRPP promotion.

We are reporting our 7 buckets of activities under the work contained in 1. MHRDD and 2. Myanmar found in the lobby logbook. One MHRDD and two Mynmar activities comprise multiple actions and meetings including follow ups, many meetings etc.

ETI aims to conduct 50 L&A activities with different actors such as government officials, political leaders, media personnel, directly engaged brands (member brands of ETI or FW), indirectly engaged brands (not member brands of ETI or FW), TUs/ LRO and other actors towards improvement of labor rights. (Language: English)
